# Advisories the dependency audit may ignore (scripts/audit_dependencies.py).
#
# Keep this list empty. Upgrade the affected package instead; add an entry
# only when no fixed release exists yet or the fix cannot be taken right
# now, and say why the advisory does not reach groundinsight's code paths.
#
# Format, one advisory per line (id as pip-audit prints it):
#
#     <advisory id>  # <why it does not affect groundinsight>; until YYYY-MM-DD
#
# Example (commented out):
#
#     GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx  # only in the docs toolchain, never shipped; until 2027-01-31
#
# The end date is mandatory. After it, the audit fails until the entry is
# removed or renewed with a fresh reason -- an exception nobody re-examines
# becomes permanent.
